title: ConCISE: A Reference-Free Conciseness Evaluation Metric for LLM-Generated Answers

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the alignment of the proposed ConCISE metric with human annotations using Spearman and Kendall rank correlations, and comparing its accuracy against standard LLM-as-a-judge baselines (e.g., GPT Ranking) that are known to exhibit verbosity or length bias by preferring overly long outputs.
